title: Wrong-archetype creatures (1/2): spiders, wolves, mimic, shark, flinx, tortoise, salamander
player_outcome: The Wolf and Hellhound are canines, not horned unicorns. The Black Recluse, Wall Creeper and Blood Crawler are eight-legged spiders. The Mimic is a toothy chest on legs, the Shark a shark, the Snow Flinx a fur ball, the Giant Tortoise a tortoise and the Salamander a lizard.
design: Verified: the steed generator always builds the crystal horn (beasts.py:93-101); crab serves black_recluse/wall_creeper/salamander/giant_tortoise; present serves the mimic; gel serves snow_flinx; fish serves shark (assets.json creatures + data model refs).
Add props texture layers fur, chitin and bone to tools/textures/props.json (appended) and rebuild the props set.
beasts.steed: horn param (default false except unicorns) and head 'canine' (muzzle, pointed ears, fur tail) for wolf/hellhound.

New bgen/fauna2.py: spider (cephalothorax, abdomen, 8 jointed legs, fangs; rig with leg pairs and a skitter walk via creatures._action), lizard (salamander), tortoise (domed shell via detail.organic), mimic (chest from furniture.chest geometry + teeth_row + stubby legs, hop/bite clip), flinx (fur-ball organic with prop:fur), shark (fish variant: dorsal fin, grey, teeth).
assets.json creatures: new entries; data/enemies/*.json models re-pointed.
Target 1–3k tris each; small rigs with idle/walk/attack clips.
Rebuild the creatures and their preview sheets.
files_modify: data/enemies/*.json — model refs (wolf, hellhound, black_recluse, wall_creeper, blood_crawler, mimic, shark, snow_flinx, giant_tortoise, salamander)
